settings.title: Settings
settings.receiver_emails_list: Enter an email address per line
settings.whitelists: Allow list of CIDR, IP and fully qualified domain name
settings.ban_local_network_tips: When enabled, CrowdSec can block IP addresses from private networks. Use with caution to avoid blocking trusted devices.
settings.bantime_tips: The 'Fixed' mode applies a ban with a constant duration, while the 'Incremental' mode extends the ban duration based on the number of failed attempts.
settings.static_bantime_increment_description: Use the same duration for every block
settings.dynamic_bantime_increment_description: Increase the duration for repeated detections from the same IP
settings.disable_online_api_tips: The central API is used to retrieve blacklists and to have a glance on metrics at app.crowdsec.net
settings.enroll_instance_must_be_real_token: The enroll key can be obtained from the CrowdSec website and grants access to different flavors of the CrowdSec Community Blocklist.
settings.helo_host_must_be_relevant_for_smtp: If notifications are marked as spam, set a custom sender domain. It will also be used for the HELO/EHLO command. Leave empty to use the node's FQDN.
settings.token_not_valid: The token provided is not valid
settings.whitelists_tips: No ban will occur for members of this list
settings.smarthosts_is_needed_to_send_notificatio: To receive mail notifications from Crowdsec, change the cluster's email settings
settings.group_threshold_tooltips: Email are sent each 24h or when the number of new alerts reaches this threshold
settings.pull_community_blocklist_tips: Disabling stops receiving community IPs and deletes existing CAPI decisions

unban.title: Banned IP
unban.unban_tooltip: IP addresses that failed multiple login attempts are listed here. You can unban them if needed

alerts.title: Detections
alerts.tooltip: Detection events are raised by CrowdSec scenarios when an IP address matches a known attack pattern (e.g. repeated SSH failures). A detection event does not always result in a ban.
alerts.page_description: Detection events raised by CrowdSec scenarios.
alerts.confirm_delete_message: All CrowdSec detection events will be permanently removed from the database. Existing bans and decisions will not be affected. This action cannot be undone.

collections.title: Collections
collections.tooltip: Collections are bundles of parsers and scenarios. Each collection adds detection support for a specific service (e.g. SSH, Nginx, WordPress). The corresponding service must be installed on the server. Enable a collection to start monitoring that service, disable it to stop.
collections.hub_description: Visit the Hub to see exactly what is included and what each collection detects.

capi.title: Threat Intelligence
capi.tooltip: CrowdSec Central API — connection status and CAPI blocklist lookup
capi.status_disconnected: Not connected to CrowdSec Central API
capi.capi_disabled: Enable the Central API in Settings to use this feature.
capi.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address
capi.no_results: IP not found in CAPI blocklist

blocklists.title: Blocklists
blocklists.tooltip: Manage IP addresses blocked locally, blocked by the CrowdSec community, and IP addresses allowed to bypass blocking
blocklists.allowlist_info_description: IP addresses, CIDR ranges and hostnames listed here will never be blocked, even if flagged by a detection scenario.
